text: I have been here on 2 occasions and found them very professional and helpful. Once to refix a crown and another to investigate tooth sensitivity. The dentist speaks good English and clean advice.

My partner and I came in for a routine cleaning. Got a next day appointment. Priced reasonably and literally the best dentist experience either of us have ever had. The least amount of pain from a cleaning. Very impressive 😇🙏🏽 …

Disappointed!!

I went there fix a front tooth filling that had come out. They did the job but the filling popped out again after only 2.5 months. I went back there to show them and ask to please fix it. They gave me my money back and said to go somewhere else and they will not do it.
So I now I am left with a hole bigger than when I went there and they refuse to repair their own work and will hand it over to someone else to deal with. They probably assumed I was a tourist they will never see again.
For this experience, I do not recommend to others.

Great service provided! The doctor and the staffs are very nice and they take the time to explain what they are going to do. The place is also very clean. By the way, the doctor provides a good anesthesia, so no pain is felt during the cares. About the prices, they are really honest and affordable.

Well.. my teeth are clean.. but I don't know. Maybe I caught her on a bad day..
I went in for a cleaning. I'm used to a dentist and their assistant being a bit more accurate and deliberate with their tools.  She also barely touched my teeth or spent any time with the polishing tool.. considering the price..  give your customers a full polish.

I will try somewhere else before going back here but the appointment availability, parking and road access is quite convenient.

text: A wonderful clinic. The wire on my retainer broke. I came in and made an appointment. They changed everything the next day, and it was a budget-friendly procedure.
The service was excellent, and the prices were reasonable. The doctor was very polite, and the staff at the counter were also very friendly and helpful.
